0022600132.text: The Miami Heat (0-4) come into this game in the 5th game of their season, having lost four straight, with a 0-3 home record and 0-1 on the road, and they sit 5th in the Southeast, three games back. The Atlanta Hawks (2-2) are 2nd in the Southeast, one game back, and have dropped their last two games, and they will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Heat won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 143-117 win in Miami on April 12, 2026.
